title: Magento to Shopify migration
subtitle: Use XTERRA’s US-site needs to understand data, search and transaction continuity.
inputs: Old/new URLs and data exports
Migration scope, cutover window and decision owner
deliverable: Data and URL mappings, rehearsal results, and a production cutover and recovery plan.
note: Read-only review of tentenco/xterra-website at e1caa5ecdcdf: Astro/Sanity with Shopify hosted checkout, a Klaviyo adapter and Draft setup scripts. The README and integration guide differ. Live accounts, complete Magento data/redirect mappings, actual sends and launch dates were not checked. Repository documents do not establish production acceptance.

title: Shopify ecommerce launch
subtitle: Check transactions, GA4, Meta, Google Ads, search and cutover in order.
inputs: Storefront/checkout domains, repository version and secure connections
Markets, transaction/delivery policies, channel plan, test orders and authorization
deliverable: A tested launch checklist covering transactions, measurement, catalog and search, with a go/no-go decision and open items.
note: A default review baseline for ecommerce projects. Apply Meta/Google integrations and operating tools to the market, consent rules and channel plan. Installing apps, activating campaigns and sending messages still require applicable authorization.
